title: SS14 "Tartarus" Season Update Log
tldr: Tartarus (SS14) launches Oct 15 at 7 PM PDT (Oct 16, 02:00 UTC). It adds Followers, beasts earned in Caged Beast encounters that fight with exclusive Tartarus skills, plus a Clockwork Core-based third trait for Youga. Seven spells, 52 supports and five legendaries are new, while several top hero traits, supports and Banishment divinity affixes are nerfed and Memory Revival, looting and trading get improvements.
highlights: Youga's third trait, The Ultimate One, centers your main spell on a Clockwork Core.
Followers from Caged Beast encounters wield exclusive Tartarus and Primal Tartarus skills.
Seven new spells, 52 new support skills and five new legendaries.
Rehan, Rosa, Selena and Sage traits and Banishment divinity affixes are nerfed.
Ultimate Memories can be revived repeatedly, and filtered loot no longer slows big drops.

changes.text: The Ultimate One puts Clockwork Core in your main spell's second support slot, and 180% of your Cooldown Recovery or Duration bonuses boost its damage, capped at 48%.
Caged Beast encounters drop Followers of four species (Lion Queen, Lone Wolf, Mammoth, Witch Rat), and higher-quality ones have more skill slots.
Followers use exclusive Tartarus skills, such as a Primal Raging Warcry that makes enemies take 50% more attack hit damage.
Witch of the Night grants up to 8% more spell damage, and Twin Inquisitors can duplicate Warden's Cache loot at up to a 28% chance.
Seven new spells, including Psionic Missile, Moon's Dawn and Voltaic Ripple, each come with 2 to 4 dedicated supports.
33 new general supports arrive, such as Honed Edge (+20% more damage) and Mana Convergence.
Five new legendaries include Illusory Chimera boots (40-50% Movement Speed) and Immolating World, which turns your Main Skill into a Level 20 True Flame Immolation.
New Afterlight compasses arrive, plus a Wild War Compass that adds Trial: God of War to a level.
Seething Silhouette now gives 10-34% more damage while Berserk, down from 20-44%.
Born to Cleanse drops from 20-48% to 10-34%, and Boundless Sanctuary's cap from 50-90% to 40-80%.
Dance of the Deep's Terra damage modifier goes from +0-20% to -20-0%.
Razor Leaf falls from 10-14% to 8-12%, and Everlasting Nectar's cap from 60-100% to 30-70%.
Level 20 base damage drops for Thornfield (486 to 405) and Tidewell (507-942 to 366-680).
Level 20 base damage rises from 332-616 to 465-863.
Thunder, Flame and Frost Core sentries activate in 0.2s instead of 0.3s, and Thunder Core's per-jump delay halves to 0.15s.
The Thunderstrike multiplier falls from 90% to 54%, and Level 20 current damage from 164-304 to 137-254.
The fireball now bursts on contact into 3 smaller fireballs rather than at the end of its flight.
Its speed-to-damage conversion now ignores any Projectile Speed beyond 200%.
Psychic Burst (35.5% to 30%) and Electric Punishment (20% to 16%) lead a round of support damage cuts.
Spell Concentration's area penalty and Control Spell's crit penalty are halved, but their damage bonuses shrink (32% to 30%, and 37.5% to 32% now for hits only).
Deception's on-kill explosion chance falls from 100% to 50%, and Hunting's speed bonus from 150% to 120%.
Ralph's Dreadcrest swaps its Trauma affixes for stacking Laceration, and Eternal Sun regenerates 8% of max Life per second below full Life.
Banishment affixes are cut across the board, e.g. Burst from 30% to 10% and Provision from 100% to 40%.
Ultimate Memories can be revived repeatedly at a rising cost, while tier-up odds fall from 30% to 20% and T0 values rise about 23%.
Most True Damage, including Thornfield and on-kill explosions, no longer scales with damage-to-Life bonuses.
Legendary Compasses now drop from Timemark 8, in far smaller numbers than at Profound.
Items your filter hides no longer stall the rest of a big drop.
Memory affixes can be auto-reconstructed toward an affix and tier you choose.
Search-condition presets can be saved and shared, and Followers and Tartarus skills are now tradable.
